query.help: Search for items on Nvidia. Example: nvidia search query "my search term" --limit 20 --table nvidia search query "keyword" --filter "price:lt:100" nvidia search query "keyword" --properties "title,price"
query.usage_instructions: Use `nvidia search query` when you need to search for items on nvidia. Required arguments: query. Common flags: --limit/-l, --filter/-f, --table/-t, --properties/-p.

item.help: Get details for a specific item. Example: nvidia search item abc123 --table nvidia search item "https://example.com/item/abc123" nvidia search item abc123 --properties "title,price"
item.usage_instructions: Use `nvidia search item` when you need to get details for a specific item. Required arguments: item_id. Common flags: --table/-t, --properties/-p.

list.help: List items from Nvidia. Example: nvidia search list --limit 100 --table nvidia search list --filter "status:active" nvidia search list --properties "id,name,status"
list.usage_instructions: Use `nvidia search list` when you need to list items from nvidia. Common flags: --limit/-l, --filter/-f, --table/-t, --properties/-p.

wildcard.help: Search items with wildcard pattern matching. Supports * wildcards for pattern matching across all string fields. Browser CLIs use client-side search.
wildcard.usage_instructions: Use `nvidia search wildcard` when you need to search items with wildcard pattern matching. Required arguments: query. Common flags: --table/-t, --limit/-l, --properties/-p.

search.usage_instructions: `search` commands for `nvidia`. Use this group for the search nvidia surface.

login.help: Configure authentication credentials. Prompts for required credentials based on the tool's authentication type. For OAuth authorization code flows, opens a browser for user consent.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to save credentials to

login.usage_instructions: Use `nvidia auth login` when you need to configure authentication credentials. Common flags: --profile/-p, --force/-F, --credential-type/-c.

logout.help: Clear stored credentials and browser sessions.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to clear credentials from

logout.usage_instructions: Use `nvidia auth logout` when you need to clear stored credentials and browser sessions. Common flags: --profile/-p.

status.help: Check authentication status across profiles. Performs a live round-trip for every configured credential type so the report reflects ground truth — not on-disk belief. Saved credentials whose live verification fails are reported as ``authenticated: false`` with the failure reason in ``api_test`` (API/OAuth) or via the live browser check (browser_session).

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to check (defaults to all profiles)

status.usage_instructions: Use `nvidia auth status` when you need to check authentication status across profiles. Common flags: --profile/-p, --table/-t.

test.help: Test authentication by verifying credentials work across profiles.
test.usage_instructions: Use `nvidia auth test` when you need to test authentication by verifying credentials work across profiles. Common flags: --table/-t, --verbose/-v, --profile/-p.

list.help: List all profiles and show their auth types and active state.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of profiles to return

options.name: --properties
options.help: Comma-separated list of fields to include

get.help: Get details for a specific profile.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to get details for

create.help: Create a new profile from .env.example template.

delete.help: Delete a profile and its data.

remove.help: Delete a profile and its data.

select.help: Activate a profile within its auth type.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to activate within its auth type

select.usage_instructions: Use `auth profiles select NAME` to activate NAME within its auth type. Other auth types keep their active profiles unchanged.

profiles.usage_instructions: Use `nvidia auth profiles` when you need to manage authentication profiles.

auth.usage_instructions: Authentication commands for `nvidia`. Use `nvidia auth login`, `nvidia auth status`, and nested `auth profiles` commands to manage credentials and profiles.

clear.help: Remove all cached responses. Deletes every file in the cache directory ({storage_dir}/cache/) and reports how many files and bytes were freed.
clear.usage_instructions: Use `nvidia cache clear` when you need to remove all cached responses.

cache.usage_instructions: Cache management for `nvidia`. Use these commands to inspect or clear cached CLI responses when you need a fresh read.

usage_instructions: Use the `nvidia` CLI for cli interface for nvidia (browser automation). Commands follow `nvidia <group> <action>`; check auth first with `nvidia auth status` and prefer `--table/-t` for human review when a command supports it.
